title: Need some advice on Ai usage
author: WestSheepherder4747
selftext:
Currently semi experienced using ai for mod building.

However, I have been trying to use it in Ue5 now with Opus 5 and Astra with little to no progress due to running out of usage so fast.

I am on the 20$ Claude plan and the GPT Plus plan (got it free as student). I have been unsuccessful trying to remedy this by having the agents work one after the other with a collab md document in the project, but it seems to be more trouble than its worth. 

If I bite the bullet and get a 100$ plan for one, which should I go with? I am leaning GPT atm due to astra but I want to know your experience/advice. Thanks for your time reading this if you made it this far. Any tips are appreciated.

Note: I have been trying prompt smarter and give more detailed instructions but its a moot point as whenever usage run out and the other works on it, the train of thought seems to get derailed.
